images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 is the edit target. Deliver ONE 1536×1024 image, same framing and exact painting style. Repaint ONLY the canyon-facing cloud edges against pure black, within a band roughly 60–180 px deep on the cloud side plus small wisps beyond. The existing edge cuts across painted billows; replace it with rounded cumulus puffs of varied size whose silhouettes follow the curves of their own billows. Each puff has warm peach/cream upper-left light and lavender/violet lower-right shadow, matching the interior painted clouds. Soft painted curved outlines, smaller puffs toward the outside, thinning vapour, outermost tiny puffs and wisps semi-transparent in appearance with black showing through and a soft fade into black. Keep each cloud bank's overall footprint and the broad central black opening; do not extend clouds more than approximately 150 px beyond the original edge. Preserve rock, cliff, grass, flowers, dirt, all non-cloud elements and the cloud interiors away from the edge exactly. Preserve original light, colors, composition and detail. All empty space remains PURE BLACK #000000: no haze, glow or gradient away from the small wisps. Hand-drawn painted 2D game environment, clean material planes, restrained texture. No new objects, no text. This is a local edge repair, preserve everything outside the specified cloud-edge bands.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — crop over black to EDIT
